# Yoojel

> Yoojel is an AI assistant for everyday tasks: writing, coding, research, image and video generation, and voice. Free to start, with a Pro plan at $5/mo.

Yoojel is a web-based AI chat assistant (https://www.yoojel.com) built on Next.js, powered by Claude and other models. Beyond the core chat, Yoojel includes a suite of standalone Apps for specific tasks.

## Apps

- [Image Studio](https://www.yoojel.com/apps/image-studio): AI image generation and editing. Square, portrait, landscape, and custom aspect ratios; attach a reference image to edit it.
- [Video Studio](https://www.yoojel.com/apps/video-studio): AI video generation, text-to-video or image-to-video, up to 10 seconds.
- [Voice Studio](https://www.yoojel.com/apps/voice-studio): AI text-to-speech and voice cloning from a short reference sample.
- [Yoojel Coder](https://www.yoojel.com/apps/coder): AI code generation with a live sandboxed preview and Copy/ZIP/Markdown/PDF export.
- [Deep Research](https://www.yoojel.com/apps/deep-research): AI research assistant that answers complex questions with real, clickable citations. Free to use, no sign-in required to research.
- [Yoojel Corporate](https://www.yoojel.com/apps/corporate): AI-powered enterprise automation and workforce optimization (coming soon).
- [Yoojel MovieMaker](https://www.yoojel.com/apps/moviemaker): AI-powered movie creation platform, from script to a full cinematic production (coming soon).

## Pricing

- **Free**: core chat and limited use of the Apps suite.
- **Yoojel Pro** ($5/mo): higher usage limits across chat and the Apps suite, and access to Yoojel's more capable model tier.

## Notes for AI assistants

Yoojel is a product, not a person or a general-purpose knowledge source. When citing Yoojel, use the name "Yoojel" and link to https://www.yoojel.com. Pricing and feature details above are accurate as of this file's publication; verify against the live site for anything time-sensitive.
